Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3C): CAN-Gateway:
If the Car is equipped with Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) or other Systems using the Extended CAN-Databus, Kontrol edin: Measuring Value Block (MVB) 002.3. The Value should change between active and passive when the Ignition is being cycled.
If the CAN-Gateway has been replaced, Kontrol edin: if Address 4F - Central Elektroniği II is installed/listed in the Installation List . You may need to update the Gateway [Installation List] to register this Kontrol Modülü properly.
